note: Declared policy, not evidence. A Free Supabase project has no managed daily backup / PITR to rely on: the logical export below is the backup. Nothing here is verified until a restore drill report exists.

targets.appliesTo: production recovery gate (measured separately from Free functional acceptance)

schedule.logicalExport: every 6 hours and before every migration
schedule.restoreDrill: monthly, and after every major migration

contents: public schema (structure + data) of the app database
migration checksums and the list applied
Auth inventory: user ids, emails, provider, created_at (no password hashes, no tokens)
Storage object manifest: bucket, path, size, sha256, plus the object copies
configuration revisions and the device key inventory (public keys only)
a list of the secret NAMES needed to run (never values)
excluded: secrets and private keys (kept in the secret store, rotated per docs/operations/secrets.md)
live sessions and refresh tokens (restored sessions grant nothing)
provider-managed schemas (auth, storage, realtime, vault, cron)

encryption.method: age or GPG to a key held outside the cloud project
encryption.keyRecovery: two named custodians; recovery tested at each drill

target.location: independent object storage chosen by the operator (not the same Supabase project)
target.costNote: storage + egress are the operator's; none is required to start the Free profile

afterRestore: in-flight jobs become 'unknown' and are reconciled by querying the other side, never replayed
refresh tokens are not restored; users sign in again
tablets re-sync from their own journals; gaps are repaired by the devices
